extension.summary: Pauses a video and warns you when an animal dies or is hurt in it (DoesTheDogDie.com)
extension.description: When any video starts - library file, TMDb Helper or any other plugin - looks the movie or episode up on DoesTheDogDie.com. When one of your chosen topics is in it, the video pauses and a box shows the topic, the votes and what voters wrote. Exit stops the video, Continue plays on. Episodes warn only when a voter named that exact episode. Needs your own free DoesTheDogDie API key (profile page on doesthedogdie.com). Powered by DoesTheDogDie.com.
extension.disclaimer: Warnings come from DoesTheDogDie.com voters and can be missing or wrong. Not affiliated with DoesTheDogDie.com.
extension.news: 0.1.1: first public version. Spam voter texts are hidden; notes when the API key is missing or rejected.
